title: What a Variable Is
objectives: Tell valid variable names from invalid ones

hook.text: An algorithm needs to remember a piece of information: an age, a name, a total it calculated. Where will it keep that information?

concept.heading: Variable = labeled box
concept.body: Think of a variable as a box with a name written on it that you can put a value into. You put the value 20 into a box named "age"; every time the algorithm says "age", it looks inside that box.

concept.heading: Naming rules
concept.body: Variable names must start with a letter, must not contain spaces, and should be meaningful. "age" is a good name, while "1age" or "my age" is invalid. Meaningful names (total, counter) make code easier to read.

exercises.question: Which of these is a variable most like?
options: A fixed sign on a wall
A labeled box you can put values into and take them out of

feedback.correct: Correct. A variable is a labeled box whose contents can change.
feedback.incorrect: A variable is like a box with its name written on it, where you can put a value and change it.

exercises.question: Which of these is a valid variable name?

feedback.correct: Correct. It starts with a letter and has no spaces or special characters.
feedback.incorrect: A variable name cannot start with a digit or contain a space or "-". "total_score" is valid.

exercises.question: What is the advantage of using "studentCount" instead of "x"?
options: It is easier to understand what the code is for

feedback.correct: Correct. Meaningful names improve readability; they do not affect speed.
feedback.incorrect: A meaningful name affects readability, not running speed.

exercises.question: Complete the sentence.
exercises.template: A variable name must always start with a ___.

exercises.question: If you put 20 and then 21 into the box named "age", what is left in the box?

feedback.correct: Correct. The new value overwrites the old one, so only the last value stays.
feedback.incorrect: When a new value is assigned to a variable, the old value is lost. Only 21 remains.

exercises.question: Which name is the best for storing a student's grade?

feedback.correct: Correct. It is short but clearly says what it holds.
feedback.incorrect: A good name is both short and clear about what it holds: gradeAverage.

summary: A variable is a box with a name on it that you can put a value into.
Names must start with a letter, have no spaces, and be meaningful.
When a variable gets a new value, the old value is lost.
